sources.title: Bertrand Toën, Derived Hall algebras, arXiv:math/0501343v4
sources.locator: Complete 24-page paper; §§1–7, PDF pp. 1–23. Read §2 homotopy cardinality and base change; §3 local finiteness and product; §4 complete associativity and unit proof; §5 Proposition 5.1 and its mapping-space exact sequence; §6 Proposition 6.1 and the hereditary case.

contents.name: §2: homotopy cardinality, component weights, base change and functoriality
contents.support: Defines finite-support functions and homotopy weights; the local component-ratio and exact-sequence arguments are supplied in the batch.

contents.name: §2, Lemma 2.6: homotopy-cardinality base change
contents.support: The local proof evaluates both sides on the same homotopy fibers and checks properness in the correct direction.

contents.name: §2, Lemma 2.3: fiber-component weight ratio
contents.support: The local proof expands the component tail and finite-group order cancellation.

contents.name: §3: locally finite dg-category and arrow moduli
contents.support: Supplies the finite-total-Hom condition and stable dg setting; the carrier specifies cohomological grading and right-module conventions.

contents.name: §2, Corollary 2.4: pushforward functoriality
contents.support: The local proof multiplies componentwise ratios and cancels the intermediate homotopy groups.

contents.name: §3, Definition 3.3: convolution product
contents.support: The carrier fixes source/cofiber/target maps and the coefficient orientation explicitly.

contents.name: §3, Lemma 3.2: local finiteness of perfect-module mapping types
contents.support: The local proof extends finite total Ext from representables through finite sums, shifts, cones and retracts.

contents.name: §3, Lemma 3.2: properness of the source/cofiber map
contents.support: The carrier proves the extension-class fiber count and finite support locally.

contents.name: §5, Proposition 5.1 proof: stabilizer and higher-Ext weight
contents.support: The local helper writes the low-degree stabilizer tail and the alternating exact-sequence cancellation.

contents.name: §4: the two correspondence squares used for associativity
contents.support: The carrier proves cartesianness by a mapping-cone calculation and a stable pullback reconstruction.

contents.name: §5, Proposition 5.1: higher-Ext formula
contents.support: The carrier proves the orbit formula from its locally established moduli and stabilizer lemmas.

contents.name: §4, Theorem 4.1: associativity and unit
contents.support: The carrier expands the pull-push base-change identity and unit fibers.

contents.name: §6, Proposition 6.1: hereditary heart comparison
contents.support: The carrier computes the negative-Ext factor and states the opposite-algebra convention forced by the current Hall supplier.

contents.name: §1 and §§5–6: naive triangle counts, Toën weighting and distinct constructions
contents.support: Supports the scope distinction; the local remark limits its claim to construction and normalization differences.
